title: Split deterministic scan from the AI wrap
description:
As a maintainer, I want scan() to run ingest, analyzers, YAML, classifier, and data-flow without importing AI enrichment or LangSmith, so that the scanner package does not drag CLI keys and tracing with it.

Feature: pipeline split

  Scenario: Deterministic scan has no AI import
    Given src/core/pipeline/scan-pipeline.ts
    When the structural path is extracted
    Then scan() does not import ai-enrichment or tracing
    And the CLI can still run AI after scan() if flags ask for it

  Scenario: Same structural result
    Given a TypeScript fixture
    When I call the deterministic scan
    Then components and data flows match today's non-AI path
